items.name: Springing into Auckland 2024
items.information:
Springing Into Auckland 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.
​
This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.
​
Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdUplIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92701aef7af516be4361993a7c4150fa9e22ea2d/image.png)


Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time.
Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in.

**First Time Competitors:**
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition.

# This competition features the most popular, easy WCA events and would make a great competition for first time competitors.

**Newcomer podiums for all events will be recognized at this competition.**

**Unofficial Event:**
We will be hosting 1 round of Mirror Blocks during lunch. Please see the tab for more information.

**Draw prizes:** 
There will be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done.

**Competition format:**
We will be using the stationary format for this competition.

**Guests**
Please let us know in your registration comment how many guests you will be bringing so we can plan seating accordingly. There is no guest limit at this venue as it is large and has extra areas for overflow seating.

**Notice of Filming and Photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

**Português**

Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes:
- Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará;
- O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele;
- Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas.
- Procure se divertir!

#### ATENÇÃO  
##### É obrigatório o preenchimento do seguinte formulário com o nome do competidor e dos acompanhantes para entrar no condomínio. Caso não preencha até o fim do período de inscrições não será possível entrar no local.
[link do Formulário](https://forms.gle/kK2EL5w1J4pqh9pY6)

**English**
It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions:
- Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate;
- The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it;
- At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice;
- If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists.
- Try to have fun!

#### ATTENTION
##### It is mandatory to fill in the following form with the name of the competitor and guests to enter the condominium. If you don't fill it in by the end of the registration period, will not be able to enter the site.
[form link](https://forms.gle/kK2EL5w1J4pqh9pY6)

items.information:
##Português

**Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. 
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**.

Pagamento da taxa via PIX: matcasvia@gmail.com

Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com 
Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor.
Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade.

**Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. A recusa não justificada poderá acarretar em desclaificação (DNF) de um ou mais eventos de acordo com a regra [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

##English

**Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**.
In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**.

Payment with PIX method: matcasvia@gmail.com

Send the payment proof to E-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com 
Send the proof with the competitor's name.
To register on site, please bring a document that proves your identity.

**Warning:** By registering for the competition, you automatically make yourself available to act as a judge, runner and/or scrambler when requested. Unjustified refusal may result in disqualification (DNF) of one or more events according to rule [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

items.information:

**Español**

¡Bienvenidos al **Cangrejito Azul 2024**, la primera competencia celebrada en Boca del Río, Veracruz! Nos complace recibir a competidores y aficionados de todas partes del país para celebrar esta competencia, en donde se podrá disfrutar de esta vibrante y acogedora ciudad.

Es un honor recibirlos Boca del Río, con sus hermosas playas y su ameno ambiente, es el lugar perfecto para relajarse y disfrutar. Por lo tanto, es ideal para que los competidores puedan demostrar sus habilidades en esta disciplina.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) antes de la competencia.

**English**

Welcome to **Cangrejito Azul 2024**, the first competition held in Boca del Río, Veracruz! We are pleased to welcome competitors and enthusiasts from all over the country to celebrate this event, where you can enjoy this vibrant and welcoming city.

It is an honor to host you in Boca del Río, with its beautiful beaches and pleasant atmosphere, the perfect place to relax and enjoy. Therefore, it is ideal for competitors to showcase their skills in this discipline.

This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens A - 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBczJJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6d41a95dbcd2b6c177ccb028ad973065c128a8aa/reunion%202024.jpg)

[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnA1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--07e81cdd5b508271bf1d27c0c873b462bead0340/image.png) 
**Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. 
Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 4x4 και Clock ή 2x2 και OH επιθυμείτε.

Μετά από τις διακοπές θα βρεθούμε ξανά για τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της νέας σεζόν! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A. **

Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού:
* 3x3
* 4x4
* Clock

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

**Note:** This competition is part A of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 
3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 4x4 and Clock or 2x2 and OH you prefer.

After the holidays we will meet again for the first competition of the new season! Come and have a good time once again at the famous Rubicon venue. We are waiting for you in **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A.**

Competition Α events:
* 3x3
* 4x4
* Clock

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information:
##### **This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3 and 2x2. This competition features "quiet" and less common events, including the main event, 3x3 Fewest Moves, which offers 9 attempts total. For a more normal competition experience, check out the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list).**

This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNSDenton2024#46556-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNSDenton2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 
  
To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).

### **Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.**

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

## [EN]

### Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [FR]

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type "favoris", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. 

Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles).

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta.


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Sandnes Open 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.information:
### 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다.
### 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 3일 내로 갱신되니, 참가 신청 이후 명단에서 본인의 이름을 확인해 주시기를 바랍니다.
### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.
원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
### Within 3 days of paying the registration fee, you should be able to see your name on either the competitor list or waitlist.
### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.name: Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw 2024
items.information:
Zapraszamy na czwartą edycję zawodów Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw! W tym roku najlepsi polscy i zagraniczni speedcuberzy będą rywalizować w bardziej popularnych konkurencjach, choć nie zabraknie side'owych akcentów. Wydarzenie odbywa się w [Pałacu Kultury i Nauki](https://pkin.pl/) - jednym z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych miejsc w Polsce. Na zwycięzców czekają nagrody finansowe zapewnione przez [Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem](https://www.szansadlaniewidomych.org/).

Turniej organizowany jest przez Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem wraz ze [Stowarzyszeniem Liga Niezwykłych](https://liganiezwyklych.pl/). Wydarzenie finansowane jest ze środków [Miasta Stołecznego Warszawy](https://um.warszawa.pl/) oraz [Mazowsza](https://mazowsze.waw.pl/). Marszałek województwa mazowieckiego [Adam Struzik](https://mazovia.pl/pl/bip/zarzad/sklad-zarzadu/adam-struzik.html) objął wydarzenie swoim patronatem.

Na konkurencję **3x3x3 Najmniejsza liczba ruchów** obowiązuje oddzielny limit zawodników: **Najlepsze 30** osób według średniej (lub pojedynczego wyniku) na podstawie zawodników zarejestrowanych.

---

We invite you to the fourth edition of the Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw competition! This year, the best Polish and international cubers will compete in the more popular events, though there will be some side events as well. The event will take place in the Palace of Culture and Science - one of the most recognizable buildings in Poland. Financial prizes for the winners are provided by the Chance Foundation - We Are Together.

The tournament is organized by the Szansa Foundation - We Are Together along with the Stowarzyszenie Liga Niezwykłych. The event is funded by the City of Warsaw and Mazovia. The Marshal of the Mazowieckie Voivodeship, Adam Struzik, has taken the event under his patronage.

For **FMC** event there is a seperate competitor limit: **Top 30** people classified by mean (otherwise single) according to the psych sheet of the registered competitors.

¡**Silence in Nayarit 2024**! La primera competencia oficial en Nayarit especializada en eventos silenciosos se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 21 y domingo 22 de septiembre de 2024.

Silence in Nayarit 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en los eventos oficiales más difíciles. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos demuestren sus habilidades.

La competencia incluirá una ronda de 3x3x3 Team-Blind, un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante.

Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.

###### English
**Silence in Nayarit 2024**! The first official competition in Nayarit specialized in silent events will be held in the city of Tepic on Saturday, September 21, and Sunday, September 22, 2024.

Silence in Nayarit 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in the most challenging official events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to demonstrate their abilities.

The competition will include a 3x3x3 Team-Blind round, an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting.

Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important that all competitors familiarize themselves with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.information:
### WCAシリーズ大会
「東海大会2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。
WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

このページは「東海大会2024」の「PM大会」のページです。
　・ [Tokai Open AM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiOpenAM2024) (**本ページでは「AM大会」と表記**)
　・ Tokai Open PM 2024 (**本ページでは「PM大会」と表記**)

各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。
　・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、3x3x3 片手 2ラウンド　開場時刻 9:00　定員72名
　・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、5x5x5 キューブ 2ラウンド　開場時刻 13:30　定員72名

### 来場時刻
AM大会については、必ず受付時間内にお越しください。
PM大会については、開場時刻の13:30までは会場に入れません。なるべく13:30から13:50の間にお越しください。

### 参加費の支払い方法
参加費は受付時にお支払いください。
支払い方法は現金のみです。

### 同伴、見学について
同伴は競技者一人につき**2名まで**とします。申込時に同伴者数を入力してください。
大会見学希望の方へ。

　観客席に僅かですが空席が生じることが分かりましたので、見学希望者の方はメールに、以下内容の記載をお願いします。

送信先：comp@cubing.nagoya

メールタイトル： 【WCA東海大会】見学希望

メール本文：

　・希望人数：〇名

　・全員の氏名：例 山田太郎、山田次郎

　・見学したい大会：AM、PM

　なお、先着順となりますので、ご了承ください。

**連絡無しの見学は絶対におやめください。**

### 当日スタッフ募集
大会を円滑に進めるために、実行委員以外のスタッフを募集します。当日スタッフにはジャッジ、スクランブラ、ランナーにご協力頂きたいと思います。
後日、当日スタッフ募集についてご案内します。

### 主催団体「TSC」とは
東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ（以下 TSC）は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」およびスピードキューバー向けの自己研鑽の場「TSCスペース自習室」を開催しています。
現在、運営スタッフを募集中です。
一緒にWCA大会やTSCスペースを開催しましょう！

### WCA Series Competitions
Tokai Open 2024 is a WCA series competition.
WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can participate in  **only one** of them.
If you apply for more than one in the same series, only the one with the earliest application time will be valid, and the others will be invalid.

This page shows Tokai Open PM 2024.
　[Tokai Open AM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiOpenAM2024) (**In this page, called "AM"**)
　Tokai Open PM 2024 (**In this page, called "PM"**)

The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows:
　AM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round,  3x3x3 One-Handed 2 rounds, open at 9:00, limit of competitors 72
　PM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 5x5x5 Cube 2 rounds, open at 13:30, limit of competitors 72
 
### Time of arrival
For the AM competition, please be sure to arrive during the reception time.
For the PM competition, you will not be allowed to enter the venue until 13:30, the time the doors open. Please arrive between 13:30 and 13:50 if possible.

### How to pay the participation fee
Please pay the participation fee at the reception.
Payment must be made in cash only.

### Requirements for non-competitors
Each competitor may bring up to two people. Please declare the number of guests at registration form.
For those who wish to visit.
　We would like to release a few empty seats in the spectators area, so if you wish to visit, please send us an e-mail with the following information.
Send to: comp@cubing.nagoya
Mail title: [WCA Tokai Open] visiting request
Mail body:
　Number of people:
　Name of all visitor: e.g. Taro Yamada, Jiro Yamada
　Competition to be visited: AM, PM
Seats will be available on a first-come, first-served basis with this email.

**Please do not visit without notification. **

### Staff Wanted on the Day
In order to ensure the smooth running of the event, we are looking for staff members who are not members of the organizer. We would like to have judges, scramblers, and runners on staff on the day of the event.
We will inform you about the recruitment of staff on the day of the event at a later date.

### About TSC, the host organization
Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as "TSC") holds "TSC Space," an off-line meeting for speedcubers, and "TSC Space Study Room," a place for self-improvement for speedcubers.
We are currently looking for an administrative staff member.
Let's organize WCA competitions and TSC space together!

##### Español
​
**¡Bienvenidos a D'Amicis Puebla 2024!**
​
Cierra los ojos e imagina... Un torneo en fechas patrias con puente, en una de las mejores ciudades para dar el grito de independencia, un mix de **9 categorías**, y darte la oportunidad de disfrutar del cierre de temporada de los deliciosos Chiles en Nogada.

​
**¡Welcome to D'Amicis Puebla 2024!**
​
Close your eyes and imagine... A tournament on holidays, in one of the best cities to celebrate "El Grito", a mix of **9 categories**, and the chance to enjoy the end of the season for the delicious Chiles en Nogada.
​
Puebla, the land of Chile en Nogada, invites you to have fun and enjoy this upcoming tournament.
​
This competition is possible thanks to the support of the **"INSTITUTO D'AMICIS S.C"**.
​
D'Amicis Puebla 2024 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.name: Örebro Minxfest 2024
items.information:
Välkomna till en tävling i Örebro med ett fokus på sidogrenar!

Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet.

Tre försök av FMC kommer att hållas under morgonen fram till lunch, så om du inte deltar i FMC behöver du inte komma till lokalen förrens lunch. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to a competition in Örebro with a focus on side events!

Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

Three attempts of FMC will be held during the morning up until lunch, so you don't have to come to the venue before lunch if you're not participating in FMC.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

The Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2024, made of multiple competitions during the whole year. 
Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final.

**Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2024 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 
4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.**
All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuietSeattleSpring2024#40461-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

[![PNW Cubing Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2QzIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fcd77227d551876bfa5fba1188db32c98f6b91f6/pnw-logos_logo-main.png)]((https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085))

This competition is a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will only be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). 

NOTE: We must have at least 16 competitors in 3BLD to have all three rounds, and 8 competitors must make it to round 2 in order to have the final (as per regulation [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m)). We may not be able to hold all three rounds if we do not meet the competitor requirements.

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Gøy på Landet 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.
  
### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoypaLandet2024#46692-forstegangskonkurrenter-first-time-competitors).
 
---
 
## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Gøy på Landet 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.
 
### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoypaLandet2024#46692-forstegangskonkurrenter-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information:
Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2024! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2024#43353-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)".

-----

Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2024!

items.information:
## SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP
A big thanks to Cubestuff who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to [Cubestuff.co.za](https://Cubestuff.co.za) to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.
A big thanks to Kitchen Nuvo for sponsoring trophies for our podium placers! Check them out on their Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/worldfocuswood?mibextid=LQQJ4d) to give some support.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

Sejam todos bem-vindos à primeira competição no Alto da XV Mall em parceria com o Capivara!

Nesta competição estamos arrecadando doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Todo o lucro da competição será revertido para esta campanha. Para mais informações, consulte a aba [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CapivaraAltodaXVMall2024#44440-campanha-beneficente).

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).


**English**
Welcome to the first competition at Alto da XV Mall in partnership with Capivara!

In this competition we are collecting donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. All profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. For more information, check the [Charitable Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CapivaraAltodaXVMall2024#44440-campanha-beneficente) tab.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=Sq18haJ3WPk2AG82).

It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

items.name: Qualifying in Kirstenhof 2024
items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce a new Cape Town competition for 2024. This competition is designed as a warmup/rankings qualifier for the [African Championships] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksWCAAfricanChampionship2024) that is coming up in September, so we will have plenty of events and plenty of rounds. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below."
​
## CHANGES TO THE FORMAT
​
We are wanting to maximise the opportunities for all the cubers in our community and as a result we have decided to make the qualifying criteria for second rounds and finals to be much more achievable. Our goal is to have more people competing in more rounds of solving!!
​
### SPECTATORS
​
Competitors are welcome to bring 2 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.
​
### VOLUNTEERING
​
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be allocated prior to the event and explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 
​
### LUCKY DRAW
​
During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.
​

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español 

Hay un límite de **60** competidores para el registro.

* El precio de la entrada es de $350 para aquellos competidores que compitan en hasta 6 categorías. Para 7 o más categorías, el precio es de $450.
* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46196-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46197-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación de la categoría, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2u) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***
# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English 

Competitor limit: **60**.

* The base entry fee for up to 6 events is $UYU 350. For 7 or more events the entry fee is $UYU 450.
* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46196-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46197-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

Bem-vindos ao Morro Reuter Cubing 2024!

🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorroReuterCubing2023/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cJNjPk_J4M).

Competidores participando pela primeira vez são obrigados a apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3' (que tomarão como base a classificação geral).

---

🇺🇸 Welcome to the first competition in Morro Reuter!

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorroReuterCubing2023/register). If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cJNjPk_J4M).

Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality.

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event (which will consider the final ranking).

items.name: Matatipac Open 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckdEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f5052380d4840da25b42fdc99bf608f4ab05e628/Matatipac%20Open%202024%20(1).png)

###### Español
¡Bienvenidos al **Matatipac Open 2024**! Esta emocionante y dinámica competencia se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 17 y domingo 18 de agosto de 2024.

El Matatipac Open 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de rompecabezas tridimensionales, principalmente eventos no cúbicos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan.

La competencia incluirá una ronda de Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante.

Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.

###### English
Welcome to the **Matatipac Open 2024**! This exciting and dynamic competition will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, August 17, and Sunday, August 18, 2024.

The Matatipac Open 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of three-dimensional puzzles, primarily non-cubic events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun.

The competition will include a round of Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting.

Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important for all competitors to be familiar with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.information:
After hosting the Canadian Championship in July 2023, Speedcubing Canada welcomes you back for BC's first Provincial Championship!

Note: While everybody is welcome to attend and compete, only BC residents will be eligible for the title of **BC Champion**. For more information, please check out the [Championship Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2024#41375-championship-eligibility).

**Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. So, if you are not competing in any events being held on Friday, then you don't need to show up until Saturday. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in-case.

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.

참가비 납부는 [대회 신청 및 참가비 납부](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanChampionship2024#42776-registration-and-payment-details) 탭을 눌러 확인해주세요. 

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

___
## Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
## Within 3 days of paying the registration fee, you should be able to see your name on either the competitor list or waitlist.
## Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information:
**This competition is not recommended for first-timers or those looking for a typical competition experience.** This will be a small competition with a selection of uncommon events. We will not be holding typical events like 3x3 and Pyraminx.

This competition will be held outdoors and will be weather permitting. We advise against booking any non-refundable travel accommodations in case the competition needs to be cancelled due to inclement weather.

There will not be total silence for blindfolded events, but there will be pleasant nature sounds.

At most one guest per competitor is permitted. Lunch and dinner for all competitors and guests is included in the registration fee. Please let us know in the registration comments if you have any dietary restrictions.

items.name: CubingUSA New England Quiet Championship 2024
items.information:
This competition is part of the [CubingUSA New England Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewEnglandChampionship2024)! Podium winners and champions of each events will be recognized at the main competition, two weeks later in Providence.

This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion.

The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 Blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition, such as the main championship two weeks later.

## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2024, for første gang holdt i Sandnes! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

### Staffing
Vi kommer til å trenge frivillige som kan bidra med ulike oppgaver under arrangementet. De som bidrar på dette teamet vil få ulike goder, blant annet refundert registreringsavgift. Les [Staffing-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) for mer info.

---

## 🇬🇧 Information
Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2024, held in Sandnes for the first time. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

### Staffing
We are going to need volunteers to help with different tasks during the competition. Those who chose to be a part of this team will get perks such as a refunded registration fee. Read the [Staffing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) tab for more info.

##Português:

**Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**.
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com o delegado (fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org)**.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Caso o limite de 50 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$30, por ordem de chegada.

##English:

**Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**.
In case of withdrawal, please **contact the delegate (fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org)**.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

If the competitor limit of 50 has not been reached, we'll be accepting on the spot registrations for the price of R$30, in order of arrival.

## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Bergen Open 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette er også helt gratis. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Nye Konkurrenter](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2024#42460-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Bergen Open 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for free aswell. We still strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2024#42460-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

### (EN)

### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

For new competitors, this video may help with competing. 
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLW9gGoCICXgJ3um3OlsrYUq1k0iAazxck

Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

### (FR)

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.


### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de compétition WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. 
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLW9gGoCICXgJ3um3OlsrYUq1k0iAazxck

Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

## Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

### 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다.
### 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 수동으로 갱신됩니다. 참가 신청 이후 3일 내로 본인의 이름이 명단에 없을 시 이메일로 문의 바랍니다.
### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

items.information:
## SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.


## NOTICE OF FILMING:

Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.

## VENUE

Oppi Dak is situated inside the Gateway Corner Centre. It is located on the first floor right above Liquor City and can be accessed via the stairs or the lift. 
The venue will provide a variety of food, snacks and drinks on both days and also offer card and cash payment options.
On Sunday they also serve a separate Buffet Lunch which you are more than welcome to take part in.
Bathroom facilities are available inside the venue, and the Centre itself also provides alternative bathrooms outside of the venue itself.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

**Español**
**¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024!**

La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad.

Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos Rubik? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. 

¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la "Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024"!

**Inglés**
**Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024!**

Guelaguetza is much more than just a festival; it's the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that characterize this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community.

And what better way to express this connection than through Rubik's Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we're not only showcasing skill and dexterity but also the ability to come together in a common challenge, regardless of our background or culture.

Don't miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where Rubik's Cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We look forward to seeing you at "Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024"!

Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu vô địch quốc gia Vietnam Championship 2024! Giải Vietnam Championship lần này sẽ có toàn bộ các bộ môn thi đấu, với nhiều môn thi đấu có từ 2 đến 4 vòng.
Xem thêm thông tin tại các tab.

# Điều kiện tham dự thi Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5

Các thí sinh tham dự các nội dung **Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5** phải đạt điều kiện sau:
* Thí sinh phải có **ít nhất một lượt** Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 thành công.
* Kết quả Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 tốt nhất của thí sinh đạt **Top 20** trong số các thí sinh đã đăng ký thi nội dung tương ứng.
Các thí sinh không đạt những điều kiện này sẽ **không được tham dự thi** các nội dung tương ứng và sẽ được hoàn 100% lệ phí các môn này (nếu đã nộp).
# Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh

Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu.
________________________________________________________________
We warmly welcome you to Vietnam Championships 2024! This year's Vietnam Championship will offer all events, many of which will be offering 2 to 4 rounds.
Refer to the tabs for more information.

# Qualification Criteria for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded
Competitors in **4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded** must meet the following qualification criteria:
* The competitor must have **at least one** successful 3x3x3 Blindfolded result.
* The competitor's best 3x3x3 Blindfolded result must be within the **Top 20** of all registered competitors of the respective event.
Competitors who fail to meet these criteria will **not be allowed to compete in the respective event** and will receive a full refund of any event fees for the events (if already paid).

# Notice on Filming and Photography
The organizers and/or present media companies may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa05zIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c3e44aec5cbb0ee93127339ad0d85620fe1e8c43/All-Star%202024%20Logo.png)
## Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024

[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/) are excited to team up with [Rubik's](https://rubiks.com) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com) to bring speedcubing all-stars together for an official WCA competition at the Mall of America® in Bloomington, Minnesota! 

## Qualification

To qualify to register for this competition, you must have an official sub-7.00 3x3x3 average. This result must have occurred at a competition that took place on or before March 21, 2024.

If you don't qualify for this competition, look for one of the many other opportunities to compete in the Midwest area, including [Minnesota Warm Up 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaWarmUp2024) on July 13 and July 14, also being held at the Mall of America! 

We also invite you to watch Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 via the livestream, or if you are in the area stop by the Mall of America® and watch it live!

## Spectators and Livestream

We're thrilled to put competitive speedcubing on display via the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 livestream. See the Livestream tab for more details.

The event will be open to in-person spectators who will be able to view this competition from mulitple levels of the Mall of America®, including on the jumbotron that will be projected in the Huntington Bank Rotunda. Reserved VIP seating will also be available for up to two guests for each competitor.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 competition consent to their images being used by Midwest Cubing Association and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

- Esta competição contará *apenas com a modalidade*  ***Clock*** ;

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

##English:

**Competitors, heed the following warnings:**

- This competition will *only have*  the ***Clock***  event;

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0Y5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cb6d356bf5594b0c88d80b79f9ce71c51f373a9e/5adbd2ae-6772-4ce6-9aab-d590f0ad777b.jpg)
To Athens TableTop Open 2024 είναι ο 6ος διαγωνισμός της WCA στην Ελλάδα για το 2024.  
Ο διαγωνισμός γίνεται στις 7 Ιουλίου 2024 στο κλειστό Ολυμπιακό γήπεδο του Τάεκβοντο στην Αθήνα στο Δέλτα Φαλήρου κατά την διάρκεια του Φεστιβάλ Επιτραπέζιων Παιχνιδιών [Athens Tabletop](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/).

Το Athens TableTop Open 2024 τελεί υπό την αιγίδα της WCA και διοργανώνεται από το ηλεκτρονικό κατάστημα [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , την [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) και την [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/), οι οποίες ανήκουν στην εταιρεία [Καινοτομίες Βερδέ ΑΕΒΕ](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste).

Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε για μια μοναδική εμπειρία και γιορτή του cubing!
Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τόσο την παρούσα σελίδα όσο και τις επόμενες σελίδες  

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί **το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντίτιμου συμμετοχής όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα** . 

Επίσης, για την είσοδό σας στον χώρο θα χρειαστεί **ξεχωριστό εισιτήριο για την έκθεση** αξίας 8 ευρώ για μία μέρα ή 14 για το διήμερο, το οποίο σας παρέχει πρόσβαση σε όλο τον χώρο της έκθεσης, όπου μπορείτε να γνωρίσετε τόσο τα προϊόντα μας, όσο και πολλών ακόμα εκθετών. Εισιτήρια για το φεστιβάλ θα βρείτε εδώ [εδώ.](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/tickets2024/)

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RS768gK0Vrg&feature=youtu.be)

Σημείωση Αποδοχής κινηματογράφησης ή φωτογράφισης. 
Οι διαγωνιζόμενοι και οι συμμετέχοντες με την συμμετοχή τους στο Athens TableTop Open 2024 αυτόματα συμφωνούν με την πιθανή χρήση των εικόνων τους από τους διοργανωτές σε προωθητικές ενέργειες, κοινωνικά δίκτυα και άλλες ψηφιακές ενέργειες.

Οι online εγγραφές ανοίγουν στη 1η Ιουνίου 2024 και κλείνουν στις 30 Ιουνίου 2024.

Athens Tabletop Open 2024 is the 6th WCA Competition in Greece during 2024. 
The competition is taking place on the 7th of July during the Festival of Board Games ["Athens Tabletop"](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/?lang=en), at the [Athens Tae Kwon Do Stadium](https://www.facebook.com/taekwondofaliro/), which is located in the Faliron Delta of Athens.

Athens Tabletop Open 2024 is an official WCA competition and is co-organized from the e-shop [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) ,  [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) and [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/), all of which are subsidiaries of [Verdes innovations S.A](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste)  .

Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules and come for an unforgettable experience and celebration of cubing!
Please read the following and the rest of the tabs very carefully.
Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should **both register though the WCA site AND pay the registration fee** as described in the adjacent tabs.

Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information. 
Additionally, for entry to the venue, **a separate ticket for the exhibition is required,** costing 8 euros for one day or 14 euros for two days. This ticket provides access to the entire exhibition area, where you can explore both our products and those of many other exhibitors. Festival tickets available through [this link.](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/tickets2024/)

Notice of Acceptance for Filming or Photography
Competitors and other Attendees of  Athens Tabletop Open 2024 consent to their images being used by the organizers and its partners in marketing and promotional actions and materials, social media and other digital platforms.
 
Online registration open 01.06.2024 and close 30.06.2024.

items.information:
Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Åkers Styckebruk! 

Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. -----

A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Åkers Styckebruk! 

Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the [concept tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept).

[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Please Be Clocked Cape Town 2024! This competition has a full array of blindfolded events, with Clock and 5x5 to mix things up. 
Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see payment details below. **Important** - if we do not have enough competitors to hold 3x3 Blindfolded Round 2, we will adjust the schedule to have 2 Rounds of 5x5 instead.

**PLEASE NOTE** This competition does NOT have 3x3 or other popular events like 2x2 or Pyraminx. If you are a newcomer, please do not register unless you are able to solve cubes Blindfolded or would like to participate in the 5x5 or Clock events.

## SPECTATORS

Spectators are only allowed as companions to competitors.

## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with **volunteering** during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler".

If any competitor or competitor's guests are willing to help judge with the blindfolded events, especially Multiple Blindfolded, please let us know. If you are able to assist with judging the longer events (4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and Multiple Blindfolded), we will reward you with a free coffee, chocolate, or other small gift :)

#### About CubingZA

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you are able to assist in any way and want to get involved, please get in touch [here](https://cubingza.org/contact)!

##### Español

**¡Bienvenidos a Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!**

Puebla, la ciudad donde la grandeza se encuentra entre volcanes, se está preparando para recibirte en un próximo torneo y poner a prueba tus habilidades. ¿Qué tan fuerte podrás llegar? ¡Esto es un reto contra ti mismo!

*¿Sabías que...?*
El triángulo se considera la figura geométrica más fuerte.
Cuando piensas en los volcanes, ¿qué categoría viene a tu mente?
Así es como Pyraminx representa diferentes aspectos de este torneo. 

Estamos seguros que no esperabas tremendas referencias con el nombre, el lugar y nuestra categoría principal. Y aún hay más, ¡échale un vistazo a los detalles y verás la fusión!

Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de  **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**.

Los Fuertes Puebla 2024 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

##### English

**¡Welcome to Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!**

Puebla, the city where greatness lies among volcanoes, is gearing up to welcome you to an upcoming competition and test your skills. How strong will you be able to become? This is a challenge against yourself!

*Did you know...?*
That triangle is considered the strongest geometric shape.
When thinking about volcanoes, which is the category that comes to your mind? 
This is how Pyraminx represents different aspects of this competition.

We're sure you weren't expecting such remarkable references between the name, location and our main event. And there's still more, take a look at the details and you'll see the fusion!

This competition is possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**.

Los Fuertes Puebla 2024 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.name: Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024
items.information:
Välkomna till Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024, den nordligaste kubtävlingen i Sverige någonsin!

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

**OBS:** Du behöver bara befinna dig i tävlingslokalen när de grenar du själv ska tävla i går av stapeln. Check-in kan genomföras när som helst under tävlingshelgen, så du behöver ej infinna dig på fredag kväll enbart för detta.

-----

Welcome to Jukkasjärvi Midnight Sun 2024, the northernmost competition in Sweden ever!

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.'

**N.B.:** You only need to be in the competition venue when the events you are going to compete in take place. Check-in can be done at any time during the competition weekend, so you don't have to show up on Friday night just for this.

items.name: Kalaallit Nunaat 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2syIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--421be8dcbd6a4e0e29893d46b60668a278a829ce/image.png)

*  This is the second speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Nuuk!
*  The competition happens on Sunday June 23rd but a workshop will happen on Saturday 22nd from 16 to 19. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Sunday afternoon!
*  The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png)

*  Una Nuummi Speedcubing-imik unamminerup aappassaraa World Cube Association-imiit akuerisaq!
*  Unammineq sapaammi 23. juni ualikkut nal. 13:10-19:45 piumaarpoq, pinnginneranilu pikkorissarneq arfiningornermi 22. juni nal. 16:00 19:00 aamma sapaammi 23. juni nal. 12-13 ingerlanneqassalluni. Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Periusinik nutaanik ilinniarit, imminullu piffissalersornissannut  sapaammi.
*  Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit piffissalersussaatit, pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu peerpata sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnera unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissikkumaarlugu. Anguniagaq tassaaginnarpoq minutsit qulit iluanni terningip naammassisinnaanngornissaa.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2cyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3511d693f3962fa6f0a96bf67ebafa277e88e75e/image.png)

*  Dette er den anden speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i Nuuk!
*  Konkurrencen finder sted søndag den 23. juni om eftermiddagen kl.13:10-19:45 , før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop lørdag den 22. fra kl. 16-19 og søndag fra kl.12-13. Tag med os til en god tid sammen med andre cubers, for at lære nye teknikker og være klar til at time dig selv søndag eftermiddag.
*  Konkurrencen er en sjov måde at time dig selv og få officielle resultater anerkendt af World Cube Association! Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!
